claim: Deterministic per-character HMAC sealing is cryptanalytically equivalent to a monoalphabetic substitution over an opaque alphabet.
implication_for_paper: Must NOT claim cryptographic confidentiality from char-HMAC OIR. Reframe: measurement of LLM behavior under referential isomorphism; security requires stronger seals + architecture.
recommended_seal_upgrades: Word/entity-level HMAC (still Zipf-leaky; better than 26-letter mono)
Per-occurrence random tokens + equality index table (isomorphism via index, not token identity)
Dual-channel: clear instructions + sealed payloads with copy-constrained decoding
